projectsSection.heading: Featured Projects
projectsSection.intro: Here are some of my recent GeoAI and spatial automation projects.

items.title: Vector Data Office Boy – QGIS Topology Cleaning Plugin (v1.0.3)
items.imageAlt: Vector Data Office Boy QGIS Plugin
items.description: All-in-one QGIS 3.x plugin that automates polygon topology auditing and geometry cleaning for spatial planning (RTRW) and land-cover datasets. Enforces a deterministic four-stage repair pipeline—resolving ring self-intersections, overlaps, internal gaps, and sliver polygons—with automatic local UTM normalization, zero external runtime dependencies, and atomic in-place overwrites.

items.title: GeoChip – Multi-Satellite Earth Observation Pipeline
items.description: Advanced geospatial preparation pipeline that accelerates Earth Observation data ingestion and computer vision annotation workflows. Combines multi-sensor satellite fetching (Sentinel-2, Landsat, Sentinel-1 SAR, MODIS, DEM) with server-side Google Earth Engine compositing via an interactive CLI and Docker engine to eliminate manual preprocessing and rapidly export single-raster chips directly into Roboflow.

items.title: PalmAI – Deep Learning QGIS Plugin (v2.0.0)
items.description: Automated spatial feature extraction system for QGIS that accelerates oil palm plantation inventory and condition monitoring from drone imagery. Combines YOLOv8 and DeepLabV3+ with A* pathfinding via a decoupled Docker architecture to eliminate OS dependency conflicts and rapidly deliver tree counts, crown centroids, health ratings, and canopy-resistant road networks.

items.title: VHR Satellite Segmentation Pipeline
items.description: Production-ready semantic segmentation pipeline that accelerates urban land-cover classification from 30 cm very-high-resolution (VHR) satellite imagery. Benchmarks SegFormer, DeepLabV3+, and U-Net models via containerized sliding-window tile inference to eliminate boundary edge artifacts and seamlessly produce georeferenced GeoTIFFs, polygonized GeoPackages, and cryptographic SHA-256 audit manifests.

items.title: ArcMap LULC Keyshortcuts – GIS Automation Tool
items.description: Advanced workflow automation system for ArcMap 10.x that accelerates wall-to-wall Land Use Land Cover (LULC) polygon digitization. Adapts OpenStreetMap iD Editor ergonomics (home-row W-A-S-D controls) via an integrated Python Add-In and an AutoHotkey (AHK) engine to eliminate repetitive mouse-travel fatigue and drastically speed up polygon Cut and Merge operations.
